court: High Court of Judicature at Madras
case_name: A. Pappammal vs Union Of India

parties.respondent_defendant: Union of India, Officer Commanding Raksha Suraksha Corporation, Senior Accounts Officer, Minor Azhagurani (rep by her mother and natural guardian Nainammal)

facts_of_case: Abimannan's widow seeks writ to quash proceedings allowing 50% family pension to his daughter from second marriage; alleges illegality in payment

legal_principles.principle: Children born out of a void marriage are legitimate but have no right to property other than that of their parents.
legal_principles.held: However, Section 16(3) makes it clear that such legitimacy shall not confer upon such children any right in or to any property of the person other than their parents.

legal_principles.principle: Family pension is admissible to the widow of an Army personnel up to the date of death or disqualification.
legal_principles.held: The pension will be admissible - (a) to a widow up to the date of death or disqualification which-ever is earlier;

outcome.final_order: Petitioner's prayer is allowed, respondents are directed to pay family pension and other benefits to the petitioner.

use_for_drafting: drafting a writ petition for property division in a joint family
advising on succession and inheritance rights of a widow
assisting with a partition dispute between family members
